summary: Object teardown helper: installs the initial vtable, releases the audio resource, removes this object's node from a keyed linked list, swaps to a second vtable, then frees the child allocation at this+0x4 when it is non-null.

operations.description: Install initial vtable pointer off_59E490 at this+0x0.
Release the audio resource associated with this object.
Remove this object's node from the linked list key lookup and capture its result.
Swap the vtable pointer at this+0x0 to off_59E4B4.
Guard on the child pointer at this+0x4 (this[1]) being non-null.
When the guard passes, free the child allocation at this+0x4 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Return the saved result (the free wrapper result when the guard passed, otherwise the linked-list removal result).
